root.label: Janesville GM plant closes after 2008 financial crash

events.label: Janesville GM plant closes after 2008 financial crash

slots.name: contamination amount
slots.sentence: When they left during the financial crash in 2008 and the plant closed down, not only did it devastate the community from a work perspective, but they also left $30 million of contamination and hazardous waste in the middle of the city that has never been cleaned up.

slots.name: plant age
slots.sentence: In Janesville, Wis., it was famously the site of this 100-year-old G.M. plant that was the centerpiece of the community, that employed a ton of people.
